messages:
Nora V: Hey finance team, help needed. We shipped demo hardware to the conference hotel and FedEx billed a "brokerage & duty" fee of $112.40 to my corporate card. Shipping label had "Collect: Client" but hotel refused packages. Can we reimburse and is customs duty covered?
Ibrahim K: Did you have pre-approval for the shipment method and customs? Usually shipping costs are allowed if approved, duties are allowed for product samples but we need supporting docs (commercial invoice, FedEx brokerage invoice).
Nora V: I have the FedEx brokerage invoice and the commercial invoice PDF. Uploading now. The original PO is ENG-4309 (demo kit), approved by Jules.
Sam T: Quick policy note: duties and customs brokerage are reimbursable when tied to a company-approved shipment of product/samples. If this was declared as client-paid and the hotel refused, we should reclassify to Op Expenses and reimburse. Need: brokerage invoice showing amount billed to card + proof shipment (tracking + PO) + approval.
Nora V: Attached: FedEx brokerage invoice (INV-FDX-8812), tracking 7861 2345 6789, PO ENG-4309, and Jules's approval thread. Also a short note from hotel saying they wouldn't accept incoming packages without guest present.
Expenses Bot: Reminder — attach vendor invoice and PO under category `travel/shipping` or `ops/shipping`. Missing brokerage invoice will block auto-approval.
Jules M: Confirming I approved the demo kit purchase on 2026-09-12 and agreed company covers reasonable import/duty fees for conference samples. Nora, thanks for flagging — please code to cost center "Product Demos" in the notes.
Ibrahim K: Two small flags: 1) If the carrier billed a customs hold/detention fee that's separate we usually treat as operational; 2) If this is recurring for same vendor we should add shipping instructions to avoid hotel deliveries. Finance can reimburse this once docs are in.
Nora V: Filing expense EXP-7783 now, uploading brokerage invoice + tracking + PO + approval DM. Note says: "FedEx brokerage fee due to hotel refusal; PO ENG-4309; code: Product Demos"
Sam T: We'll fast-track manual review for EXP-7783. If Finance Ops confirms vendor invoice matches card charge we'll clear for payment. Expect 3-5 business days.
Nora V: Thanks! One more Q: do I need to pursue FedEx for a refund since the label said client-collect?
Ibrahim K: You can open a claim with FedEx; attach claim ref to the expense. Finance will hold final payment until claim resolution if amount is disputable, but we can do an interim reimbursement if urgent.
Expenses Bot: Expense EXP-7783 created and assigned to Finance Ops. Status: pending manual review.
Nora V: Appreciate the help :raised_hands: I added the claim ref and flagged the vendor notes so Ops can update shipping instructions for future conferences.
